query:
SELECT
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rb_submission
                        WHERE team_id = $1 AND puzzle_id = $2 AND saction = 0)
                        AS failure_count,
                    p.penalty,
                    ARRAY_AGG(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL) AS round_ids
                FROM rb_puzzle p
                LEFT JOIN rb_round r ON r.puzzle = p.id
                WHERE p.id = $2
                GROUP BY p.id, p.penalty;
